title: Claude runtime closure pin and re-observation
description: Objective: provide the real pre-activation Windows Claude runtime preparation seam. Deliverable: an internal @moe/runner module that resolves the quote-declared installed runtime closure without a shell, canonicalizes and streams SHA-256 for every entry, creates a private content-addressed copy, verifies the copied bytes and re-hashes the source to close copy-time drift, re-observes current platform and the quote-bound version/capability facts, and returns an immutable prepared-runtime binding. The later launcher consumes this binding; this task performs no grant consumption or provider launch. NOT in scope: Job Objects/process execution, daemon/store orchestration, review/evidence receipts, or public launcher export. Real consumer: Windows Claude launch wrapper task task-acf73253a204435aba590894799814f2. Owned paths: packages/runner/src/providers/claude/claude-runtime-pin.ts, claude-runtime-pin.js, and claude-runtime-pin.test.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test.
definitionOfDone: The production surface resolves every declared closure path on Windows, rejects missing/non-file/duplicate/reparse/UNC/device or containment-escaping entries, and streams each file digest without whole-file buffering; each refusal returns exact stable RUNTIME code and layer with truth UNKNOWN.

Pinning writes only to a private digest-addressed root, never overwrites mismatching existing bytes, verifies every destination digest, and re-hashes every source after copy; drift, partial copy, cleanup failure, or unverifiable metadata remains UNKNOWN and grants no prepared runtime.

A fresh ProviderRuntimeObservation records the current OS/architecture/version, CONTENT_ADDRESSED_COPY, exact canonical pinned paths/digests, and capability-schema binding; comparison ignores freshness only and rejects any authoritative path/digest/version/capability/platform mismatch with the exact production code/layer.

Non-Windows invocation returns typed UNSUPPORTED before filesystem mutation; empty/UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED observations cannot be upgraded, and generated refusal sweeps assert a positive case count plus exact code and layer.

The immutable prepared-runtime result binds the quoted observation digest, fresh observation digest, aggregate pinned-closure digest, executable path, and pin-root identity so a later launcher cannot substitute bytes or location.

Focused runner typecheck/tests exit 0, including a large streaming fixture, copy-time mutation, destination collision, path attack, and byte-level deterministic rebuild cases; no probe, pin, or generated evidence files remain committed.
taskRails: Preparation is inert: it may read/hash/copy runtime bytes but must not execute Claude, consume an activation grant, acquire provider authority, or call daemon/store services.
Use the existing production ProviderRuntimeObservation builder; do not reimplement its canonical digest rules in a test helper.
TDD; exact stable reason code and layer for every failure, positive generated case counts, and production-surface mutation checks.
Keep production files focused, target <=250 physical lines and split before 400; stage and commit only explicit owned paths.

implementationPlan.description: TDD RED: create `claude-runtime-pin.test.ts` around the new internal `prepareClaudeRuntimePin` seam using real Windows temp trees plus a thin wrapped production FS/observation port only for deterministic fault injection. Pin the success contract (all declared closure entries copied under one digest-addressed root; mixed-case declaration order produces byte-identical aggregate/result digests; result, nested observation, closure, and binding fields are frozen) and assert the large-file case is consumed in multiple bounded chunks rather than by a whole-file read. Add positive-count generated refusal tables that assert `{ ok:false, layer:"RUNTIME", truthClass:"UNKNOWN", code }` for UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED/empty or digest-invalid quotes, missing/non-file/case-fold duplicate entries, UNC/device/traversal/containment escape, and symlink/junction/reparse paths; the non-Windows case must also assert zero filesystem and observation-port calls.
implementationPlan.note:
TDD RED landed. claude-runtime-pin.test.ts pins prepareClaudeRuntimePin: success contract (one digest-addressed root, exact pinned tree + digests, frozen result/observation/closure, pinRootIdentity), bounded-chunk streaming (3 source passes + 1 destination pass over a 262161-byte fixture, every chunk <= RUNTIME_PIN_CHUNK_BYTES), shuffled-declaration byte-identical rebuild, adopt-existing-root, published-root drift => CLAUDE_RUNTIME_PIN_COLLISION with existing bytes preserved, non-win32 => CLAUDE_RUNTIME_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED with zero fs I/O and zero facts calls. implementationPlan.description: Implement the fail-closed contract and source re-observation in `claude-runtime-pin.ts`. Define a frozen error vocabulary (separate stable codes for unsupported platform, invalid quote, invalid/missing/non-file/duplicate/reparse/escape path, source digest mismatch, pin collision/copy/destination-digest/source-drift/cleanup failure, and observation change/invalidity), with every failure fixed at layer `RUNTIME` and truth `UNKNOWN`. Validate the quote by recomputing its `canonicalDigest(observationDigestInput(...))`, require PROVEN + nonempty + `CONTENT_ADDRESSED_COPY`, then on win32 only canonicalize the declared local-drive paths beneath the canonical installed root with case-insensitive duplicate/containment checks and per-segment reparse rejection. Hash each regular source file through a fixed-size stream, sort by the repository's code-unit rule, and compare a launch-time source observation to the quote on every authority field except freshness and its derived observation digest; current platform/version/capability facts come from the injected production observation port, never copied from request authority.
implementationPlan.note:
Landed the fail-closed contract + source re-observation in claude-runtime-pin.ts. Frozen 16-code vocabulary CLAUDE_RUNTIME_PIN_ERROR_CODES; every refusal goes through one `refuse()` that fixes layer="RUNTIME" and truthClass="UNKNOWN". Quote gate recomputes canonicalDigest(observationDigestInput(quote)) and requires v1/claude + PROVEN + nonempty bounded closure + CONTENT_ADDRESSED_COPY + exactly one EXECUTABLE. win32 gate (fs.hostPlatform()) runs before any port call. Path canonicalization: LOCAL_ABSOLUTE regex rejects UNC/device/forward-slash/trailing-sep/reserved-char forms, explicit dot-segment rejection, case-folded duplicate + containment checks, per-segment ancestor walk (REPARSE/MISSING/NOT_FILE), then realpath fold-equality + containment so a junction cannot redirect a subtree. Sources hashed by streamDigest over fs.readChunks (65536-byte chunks, no whole-file buffer), per-entry compare to the quote yields CLAUDE_RUNTIME_SOURCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH, entries sorted code-unit by source-relative path. Current platform/version/capability facts come from the injected facts port (never from request authority); the source observation is built with the production buildProviderRuntimeObservation and compared to the quote via authorityDigest() = observationDigestInput minus `freshness` only.
Fresh run: `pnpm --filter @moe/runner exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/runner/src/providers/claude/claude-runtime-pin.test.ts` -> 34 passed, 10 failed (44). All 10 remaining failures are the not-yet-implemented pin/publish/binding surface (steps 3-4): the 5 success/streaming/rebuild/adopt cases, collision, destination mismatch, source drift, cleanup failure, second-observation change, and the vocabulary-coverage guard. `pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck` -> exit 0.
Also fixed three test-side defects found by this run: `??` in makeQuote/run swallowed the intentional `null` reportedVersion and the intentional non-record quote (both cases were silently running the valid path), and `join(...,"..",...)` normalised the traversal segment away so that row was testing PATH_MISSING instead of PATH_INVALID.

implementationPlan.description: Implement private content-addressed staging and publication in the same focused module: derive the aggregate closure digest from the sorted `{kind, canonical source-relative path, sha256}` manifest; canonicalize/create the caller's Moe-private local pin root before using `<pinRoot>/<aggregateDigest>`; stage in a same-parent exclusive temporary directory; create directories/files with restrictive modes and exclusive writes; stream-copy while hashing, flush/close each destination, verify its digest, then rehash every source. Never replace an existing final root: verify an already-published/concurrently-won root byte-for-byte and adopt it only on exact match, otherwise return `CLAUDE_RUNTIME_PIN_COLLISION`. On partial copy, drift, publish, or cleanup failure, close handles, attempt removal, and return the exact copy/drift/cleanup code without a prepared binding; preserve a mismatching existing destination. Keep the production file below 400 physical lines (target <=250) and do not add another authority implementation in tests.
implementationPlan.note:
Staging + publication landed. Aggregate closure digest derived from the sorted {kind, source-relative path, sha256} manifest (so declaration order and install location cannot change the pin address). Pin root shape-validated, created, realpath-canonicalized, then `<pinRoot>/<aggregateDigest>`. Staging is a same-parent exclusive directory `.staging-<digest16>-<pid>-<seq>` (mkdir non-recursive, mode 0o700); files open `wx` at 0o600. Copy streams source chunks while hashing what is written, closes the handle in a `finally`, then re-reads the destination: the write-side hash catches a source rewritten mid-copy, the re-read catches a destination that did not receive what was written. After all copies every source is re-hashed (CLAUDE_RUNTIME_PIN_SOURCE_DRIFT). An existing final root is NEVER replaced: verified per declared member AND swept for undeclared members, adopted only on exact match, otherwise CLAUDE_RUNTIME_PIN_COLLISION with the existing bytes preserved. Publish preflights the final root, renames, and on a rename throw re-checks the target to distinguish a concurrent winner (verify/adopt or collision) from a genuine copy failure. Cleanup failure outranks the copy failure it could not undo (CLAUDE_RUNTIME_PIN_CLEANUP_FAILED).
SCOPE DISCLOSURE - owned production paths grew from 1 to 4 modules. claude-runtime-pin.ts hit 458 physical lines with only the step-2 surface in it, and epic rail 5 / task rail 4 cap production files at 400 (target 250). Rather than cross the cap I split along real seams, all in the task's own directory and owned by no other task (task-4d1f8ba5 owns platform/windows/**, confirmed disjoint): claude-runtime-pin-fs.ts (FS port + node adapter + streamDigest, 122), claude-runtime-pin-closure.ts (refusal vocabulary + path/quote/source admissibility, 281), claude-runtime-pin-copy.ts (stage/copy/verify/publish protocol, 178), claude-runtime-pin.ts (facade, re-observation, binding, 301). No file exceeds 301 lines. Capability, behaviour and public surface are unchanged; the governor rail states per-file violations are worker-fixable by splitting the file. Each needs a .js bridge, added in step 4.
Also added a real gap found while writing verifyPublished: matching every declared member is not enough, an undeclared neighbour in the pinned root is exactly how a side-by-side DLL load gets in. Added fs.listFiles + an extra-member collision case and its test.
Fresh run: `pnpm --filter @moe/runner exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/runner/src/providers/claude/claude-runtime-pin.test.ts` -> Tests 45 passed (45), exit 0. `pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck` -> exit 0.

implementationPlan.description: Complete the post-copy re-observation and immutable binding. Deterministically project each proven source entry to its canonical pinned absolute path, call the existing production `buildProviderRuntimeObservation` with those exact paths/digests, freshly observed OS/arch/osVersion + reported version + adapter capability schema, pinning method `CONTENT_ADDRESSED_COPY`, and injected clock, and reject any quote/source/pinned path, digest, platform, version, capability, or builder-truth mismatch with `CLAUDE_RUNTIME_OBSERVATION_CHANGED` or `CLAUDE_RUNTIME_OBSERVATION_INVALID` at RUNTIME/UNKNOWN. Return a deeply frozen prepared result binding `quotedObservationDigest`, `freshObservationDigest`, aggregate closure digest, the unique EXECUTABLE pinned path, and a canonical pin-root identity digest. Add the exact runtime bridge `export * from "./claude-runtime-pin.ts";`; intentionally do not add a package-root export because consumer `task-acf73253a204435aba590894799814f2` imports this internal runner module immediately before grant/lock/spawn.
implementationPlan.note:
Post-copy re-observation and immutable binding complete. rebind() observes the facts port a SECOND time, projects each proven source deterministically to win32.join(finalRoot, relativePath) with its already-verified digest, and calls the production buildProviderRuntimeObservation with those exact paths/digests, the freshly observed os/arch/osVersion + reportedVersion + adapterCapabilitySchemaDigest, pinningMethod CONTENT_ADDRESSED_COPY and the injected clock. Builder failure or a non-PROVEN build => CLAUDE_RUNTIME_OBSERVATION_INVALID; facts that moved between the two observations => CLAUDE_RUNTIME_OBSERVATION_CHANGED; both at RUNTIME/UNKNOWN. Sequencing matters and is deliberate: re-observation runs BEFORE the staging rename, so a runtime that changed mid-copy leaves nothing published (the staged tree is removed and the pin root stays empty). deepFreeze'd PreparedClaudeRuntime binds quotedObservationDigest, freshObservationDigest (= observation.observationDigest), pinnedClosureDigest, pinnedRoot, pinRootIdentity = canonicalDigest({pinRoot, root}), the unique EXECUTABLE pinned path, the observation itself, and a bindingDigest over all of them - so a later launcher cannot substitute bytes or location.
Runtime bridges added for all four owned modules (claude-runtime-pin{,-fs,-closure,-copy}.js), each exactly `export * from "./<name>.ts";`. runtime-entrypoint.test.ts derives that requirement rather than reading an allowlist, and it passes. Deliberately NO package-root export in index.ts: the named consumer task-acf73253a204435aba590894799814f2 imports this internal runner module directly, immediately before grant/lock/spawn.

MUTATION DRILLS (3 run, backups kept OUTSIDE the repo tree, all restored byte-identical - verified by diffing pre/post sha256 of all owned .ts files, and `git grep DRILL HEAD` returns nothing):
1. Bypassed the post-copy source rehash (`failure ??= await confirmSources(...)` -> `failure ??= null`): 3 red - the SOURCE_DRIFT case, the three-bounded-passes streaming assertion (2 source reads instead of 3), and the vocabulary-coverage guard. The rehash is load-bearing for all three.
2. Relaxed the version field in the quote authority comparison (`delete input["reportedVersion"]` in authorityDigest): exactly 1 red, "a version that no longer matches the quote" -> CLAUDE_RUNTIME_OBSERVATION_CHANGED.
3. Relaxed the capability field the same way: exactly 1 red, the capability-schema case. Version and capability are independently bound; neither rides on the other.
ADVERSARIAL REVIEW - fixed during review: a published root whose declared members all verify could still carry an UNDECLARED neighbour, which is exactly how a side-by-side DLL load gets into a verified directory. Added fs.listFiles + an extra-member COLLISION branch + test.
Verified sound: concurrent publication (staging is `.staging-<d16>-<pid>-<seq>` so two calls in one process cannot collide; publish preflights, and a rename throw re-checks the target to distinguish a concurrent winner - verify/adopt - from a real failure; an existing root is never replaced). Handles closed in `finally` on every copy path. Cleanup failure outranks the copy failure it could not undo, so an unremovable partial tree is never masked. Cross-drive declared paths cannot reach win32.relative because isInside runs first. The installed root declared as its own member is refused (proper-descendant prefix). Windows filename quirks fail closed: trailing dot/space and 8.3 short names are caught by the realpath fold-equality check (PATH_REPARSE); reserved device names (NUL/CON) lstat as OTHER (PATH_NOT_FILE). walkFiles cannot loop on a directory symlink because readdir Dirent reports it as a symlink, not a directory. A hostile non-canonicalisable quote throws inside observationDigestInput and is caught as QUOTE_INVALID.
DISCLOSED RESIDUAL RISK (theoretical, not fixable at this layer): the per-segment reparse walk is a check-then-use against the filesystem, so an ancestor could in principle be swapped between the walk and the read. Mitigated in depth by realpath fold-equality, destination verification, the post-copy source rehash and a Moe-private pin root. Closing it fully needs handle-based traversal with FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, which is native Windows handle work owned by task-4d1f8ba54cb6476c930c46b413f882aa, not this pure module.

comments.content: Consumer edge: Windows Claude launch wrapper `task-acf73253a204435aba590894799814f2` will import the prepared-runtime result and revalidate its binding immediately before grant/lock/spawn; no public root export is required in this prerequisite.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Rejected whole-buffer reuse of `artifact-store.stageArtifact`: its `Uint8Array` API cannot prove bounded streaming for large runtimes. Rejected shell/PowerShell/icacls resolution because the task is explicitly shell-free and process execution is out of scope. Rejected trusting caller-supplied fresh facts or comparing only digests: current facts must arrive through a production observation dependency and every quote authority field must be compared. Rejected raw equality between installed and pinned absolute paths: the quote is checked against a freshly resolved source observation first (ignoring only freshness and its derived digest), then the proven source-relative manifest is deterministically projected into the content-addressed pin root and rebuilt through the existing observation builder. Rejected public `@moe/runner` export because the named consumer is an internal runner launch wrapper.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Stale-disk measurement (PowerShell `Test-Path` over all owned paths plus `git status --porcelain -- <owned>`): all three owned files are absent and their owned status is clean, so this plan creates rather than duplicates them. `packages/runner/src/providers/claude/claude-observation.ts` already defines `ProviderRuntimeObservation`, `RuntimeClosureEntry`, `buildProviderRuntimeObservation`, `observationDigestInput`, `CONTENT_ADDRESSED_COPY`, PROVEN/UNKNOWN, and canonical code-unit closure sorting; reuse those production surfaces. `packages/runner/src/canonical.ts` provides `canonicalDigest` and `deepFreeze`; its `sha256Hex` is whole-buffer only and is not the streaming implementation. `runtime-entrypoint.test.ts` automatically requires an exact `.js` bridge for every runtime `.ts` module, so the owned bridge is mandatory and no allowlist edit is needed. Existing `scope-observation.ts` demonstrates win32 case folding/realpath containment but is worktree-specific and must not become runtime authority. The authoritative design was measured at provider-launch section 13: compare path/digest/version/capability/schema to the quote before activation and pin by private content-addressed copy. This pure preparation capability's real consumer is task-acf73253a204435aba590894799814f2.
planningNotes.risks: Windows path identity is case-insensitive and device/UNC names can bypass naive `resolve`/prefix checks; normalize with win32 semantics, reject device/UNC forms before filesystem access, case-fold duplicate/containment checks, and inspect every ancestor for reparse behavior. Windows rename can replace some existing targets; stage a directory on the same volume, preflight final-root absence, never rename over an existing root, and on a concurrency race verify/adopt the winner rather than overwriting it. Always close streams/handles before cleanup. Source bytes may change during copying, so both destination verification and a second source hash are mandatory. The quote's installed paths and the final pinned paths are intentionally different: equality is enforced on the fresh source observation before deterministic path projection, not weakened by ignoring path fields. If the single production source approaches 400 lines, stop and request an owned-path split rather than cross the cap.
